headline: JOJO Limited sets October 12 record date for 1:1 bonus share issue
hook: Record date approaches for 1:1 bonus issue
summary: JOJO Limited shares closed 1.33% higher at ₹228 on October 9 ahead of its upcoming 1:1 bonus issue record date on October 12. The stock has delivered a 106% return over the past six months. Retail investors holding shares by the record date are eligible for the bonus issue.
whats_next: October 12, 2026 record date for bonus shares
why_it_matters: Bonus shares increase your holding quantity but adjust price proportionately.
